rows.note: Use 探索 as the all-purpose noun for the process of exploring or investigating, including neutral geographical discovery.

example.english: Our exploration this time is mainly about studying this cave.
example.traditional: 我哋今次嘅探索，主要係研究呢個山洞。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 ge3 taam3 sok3 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 jin4 gau3 ni1 go3 saan1 dung6

rows.note: Choose 探險 for geographical exploration presented as an adventurous journey into unknown places.

example.english: They’re planning an exploration trip to Antarctica next year.
example.traditional: 佢哋計劃下年去南極探險。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 gai3 waak6 haa6 nin4 heoi3 naam4 gik6 taam3 him2
